arguments.message: Hanging on the wash and pod reserve under 30 pct: cue let_go now unless cp_implied_w shows the calibration is low.

text: no cue: on the wash at 183 W shaft, reserve 92 pct; hanging on is the efficient use of reserve for now, watch set to cue let_go before it empties.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s >= 90 and distance_m < 0.35 * (distance_m + remaining_m) and push_local_mps - push_along_mps < 0.05 and empties_in_m_pod < remaining_m - maximum(300, 0.1 * remaining_m)
arguments.message: off the wash: pod reserve runs out well before the finish at this shaft power
pod reserve reads empty but speed at this rate holds: shaft critical power probably set low

arguments.condition: remaining_m > 0 and remaining_m < 800 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.3 and fade_pct >= -2
arguments.message: pod reserve left near the finish and speed holding: consider finish cue

text: no cue: boat-model alert is a wash artefact; shaft power 163 W is below shaft critical power 165 W with pod reserve 89 pct, so hanging on is sustainable.

arguments.text: Slipping off the wash, close up and sit on it.

text: hang_on: wash benefit fell from 0.12 to near 0 m/s after the turn at steady 163 W; the wash cost is below shaft critical power with 87 pct pod reserve, so it is worth keeping.

arguments.text: Drifting back, lift a little and get on their wash.

text: hang_on: wash excess (local minus along push) fell from 0.08 to about 0.01 over three minutes at steady 162 W; that effort is under shaft critical power with 84 pct pod reserve, so the wash is worth keeping.
no cue: just turned for leg 1; effort 162 W is under shaft critical power with 84 pct pod reserve, and a wash cue was just given, so let it take effect.
no cue: back on the wash (3.22 m/s through the water at 164 W, under shaft critical power), pod reserve 80 pct and falling slowly, so pacing is sound.
no cue: turning onto leg 2 on the wash at about critical shaft power with 80 pct pod reserve; nothing to change.
no cue: holding 164 W shaft (just under critical) at 3.19 m/s with the pack, pod reserve 77 pct falling under 1 pct a minute, so there is enough left for a finishing sprint.
no cue: turn onto leg 1 at 4 km, steady 164 W shaft with 77 pct pod reserve and no fade; nothing to change.

arguments.message: about 600 m to go with pod reserve left: cue finish now (the sprint from the pack is best spent over the last 1.5 to 3 minutes)

text: no cue: halfway, holding the pack at 164 W shaft with 74 pct pod reserve and no fade; saving the surplus reserve for a sprint from about 600 m.
no cue: turn at halfway, steady 164 W shaft with 74 pct pod reserve and speed holding; nothing to change.

arguments.text: Gap opening, close it now and stay on their wash.

text: hang_on: wash signal dropped sharply in the last 10 s and speed dipped at the same power; staying on costs about critical shaft power with 70 pct pod reserve and 4 km left, which is affordable.
no cue: just turned at 6 km and a wash cue was given seconds ago; effort is at critical shaft power with 70 pct pod reserve.
no cue: on the pack at 3.22 m/s, 165 W shaft (at critical) with 66 pct pod reserve and no fade, 3 km left; saving the reserve for the sprint.
no cue: turn at 7 km with the pack, at critical shaft power and 66 pct pod reserve; nothing to change.
no cue: 2 km left, on the pack at 3.2 m/s with 61 pct pod reserve and no fade; keep the reserve for the sprint from about 600 m.
no cue: turn at 8 km with the pack, 61 pct pod reserve; sprint planned from about 600 m.
no cue: 1 km left with the last turn just ahead; stay on the pack wash and sprint from about 600 m on the 56 pct pod reserve.
no cue: final turn done, 1 km left on the pack wash with 56 pct pod reserve; sprint cue due at about 600 m.

arguments.text: Six hundred to go, go now, empty it to the line.

text: finish: 589 m left with 54 pct pod reserve (about 206 W holdable to the line), so the surplus goes into the final sprint now.
